title: InterWebCoder: Learning Interactive Webpage Generation from Executable Tests via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interactive webpages underpin modern applications, but reproducing both their visual appearance and multi-step behavior remains challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Scalable training data must capture user actions, state transitions, and expected outcomes, while real-world webpage code is often entangled with irrelevant scripts and external dependencies. Moreover, existing GUI-agent-based verification provides slow and potentially unstable functional feedback. To address these challenges, we propose InterWebCoder, an efficient framework for interactive webpage code generation. InterWebCoder introduces a Test-Specification-Guided and Execution-Verified Data Synthesis pipeline that records real-world interaction trajectories and synthesizes self-contained webpage code with executable test scripts. A failureattributed repair mechanism uses runtime evidence to locate and iteratively fix errors in either the webpage code

translated_title: InterWebCoder：通过强化学习从可执行测试中学习交互式网页生成
translated_abstract: 交互式网页是现代应用的基础，但对于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）而言，复现其视觉外观和多步骤行为仍然具有挑战性。可扩展的训练数据必须捕获用户操作、状态转移和预期结果，而真实世界的网页代码往往与无关脚本和外部依赖项纠缠在一起。此外，现有的基于GUI智能体的验证方法提供的功能反馈缓慢且可能不稳定。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了InterWebCoder，一个高效的交互式网页代码生成框架。InterWebCoder引入了测试规范引导与执行验证的数据合成流水线，该流水线记录真实世界的交互轨迹，并合成带有可执行测试脚本的自包含网页代码。失败归因修复机制利用运行时证据来定位并迭代修复网页代码中的错误……
tldr: 提出InterWebCoder框架，通过测试规范引导与执行验证的数据合成流水线生成带可执行测试脚本的高质量交互式网页训练数据，并利用强化学习从可执行测试中学习交互式网页代码生成。
en_tdlr: InterWebCoder is an efficient framework that learns interactive webpage code generation via reinforcement learning, using a test-specification-guided and execution-verified data synthesis pipeline that produces self-contained webpage code with executable test scripts.
